Reason for Mistake: In the very first turn (Step 1), the WebSurfer agent hallucinated a fact. It claimed that a search result found an infobox stating Selim II's nationality was "Venetian." This is historically incorrect and contradicts the actual search results visible in the conversation log (which showed Wikipedia and Britannica confirming he was an Ottoman sultan).
